metadata.title: Lunar site illumination and Earth visibility dataset
metadata.important: This file intentionally contains no fabricated sunrise, sunset, illumination percentage, or Earth-visibility windows. These are time-dependent quantities and should be computed from a documented ephemeris/terrain model or loaded from a verified NASA dataset.
metadata.recommendedComputation: Use a lunar ephemeris plus site coordinates, local horizon/topography, solar position, and Earth position. Label results as model estimates and record model/version/time basis.
